notes: BUG-120/D1+D3: profiles freeze the recorded command text. status=candidate means the text was prepared from a real recording but never accepted on a target host; only the development driver (CREO_MECHDOG_PANEL_CANDIDATE) may use it. Recording originals are preserved under recordings/ and are never rewritten. select_command is the resident command named at runtime; the recorded @PAUSE_FOR_SCREEN_PICK steps are replaced by one invocation per position, because a pause waits for a human click.
